subject: Re: Promo stacking & dedicated conversion — SeedFoundry accelerator
messages:
From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@seedfoundry.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Promo stacking request for SeedFoundry cohort

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. SeedFoundry is finalizing cohorts for Q4 and weʼre hoping to confirm a promo stack that includes: 60,000 free tokens for the cohort sandbox, a 3-month 25% discount on Dedicated conversion, and co-branded onboarding support. Our partners are asking for a simple MOU they can sign this week.

Key asks:
- Extra sandbox credits for demo day (one-time)
- A short trial-to-dedicated conversion discount to lower friction
- Legal-friendly one-page MOU (no long redlines)

I attached the request form with our anticipated usage numbers. Are these items something Redwood can support as a partner package, or do we need to split into two approvals (credits vs pricing)?

Appreciate any fast guidance — weʼre under a deadline to commit partners by Friday.

Best,
Sylvia Kim
Head of Programs, SeedFoundry
[sylvia.kim@seedfoundry.com]

Attachments: SeedFoundry_Promo_Request_Form.xlsx
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@seedfoundry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo stacking request for SeedFoundry cohort

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks for the clear asks and the spreadsheet. Quick read: the sandbox credit request is reasonable for a one-off demo day, and we do have an exception path for partner cohorts. Pricing discounts for Dedicated conversions are governed by commit windows and finance approval.

To move fast I propose the following conditional package we can present in an MOU:
- Sandbox credit: 60k tokens one-time (applies to the cohort billing contact)
- Dedicated discount: 20% off list for first 3 months if cohort converts to a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days of pilot end
- Co-branded onboarding: included (1 day onboarding + priority CS office hours for first 30 days)

If you confirm acceptance, I can circulate a one-page MOU (tick-box terms) and loop Contracts. If you prefer 25% weʼll need a short exception signoff from Revenue Ops.

Can you confirm which company entity signs and whether SeedFoundry requires a PO?

Best,
Irene Choi
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Thanks Irene — helpful. A couple follow-ups from our side:
- SeedFoundry signs as SeedFoundry LLC (same as previous pilots). No PO — we usually accept a countersigned MOU or a DocuSign.
- The cohort lead asked if the sandbox credits can be applied as "per-team" buckets (i.e., split across 6 teams) — thatʼs fine as long as total credits are exhausted at the account level.
- About discount: we were hoping for 25% for at least the first month (to offset early overages) and 20% after that. If that requires revenue ops approval, can you escalate?

Weʼll review the one-pager and share redlines quickly. Also attaching a short partner one-pager with our cohort timeline.

—Sylvia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Promo stacking request for SeedFoundry cohort

Ben / Irene — forwarding SeedFoundry asks. TL;DR: one-time 60k sandbox credit + request for a front-loaded 25% discount on conversion. Finance floor for partner discounts is typically 20% without written commit; we can stretch to 25% with a short-term approval and if we get a 6-month reserved commit.

Proposed internal approval path:
- Approve sandbox credit (ops approves one-off)
- Approve 25% discount for month 1 and 20% thereafter for first 3 months if SeedFoundry signs the 6-month reserved commit within 30 days
- Ask Contracts to draft a 1-page MOU with a simple conversion addendum (DocuSign-ready)

Ben — can you greenlight the 25% front-load? If not, we present 20% up front and reserve 25% for marquee partners.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Sep 2, 2027 at 11:18 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai> wrote:

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo stacking request for SeedFoundry cohort

Thanks for the context. I approve the exception with the following guardrails:
- One-time 60k sandbox credit approved. Ops to charge-back if account later disputes usage.
- Discount: 25% for month 1, 20% for months 2–3, only if SeedFoundry executes a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days. If they do not execute, normal list rates apply and any applied discount will be reconciled on first invoice.
- Contracts to prepare a lean MOU and include a conversion addendum with explicit commit language.

Iʼll loop in RevOps and Finance to ensure the accounting flow is clear and request a short note for the playbook so CS knows the onboarding expectations.

Approve and move to send MOU.

Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

Hi Sylvia / SeedFoundry team —

Great news: Ben approved the exception. Summary of agreed terms (to be reflected in the MOU):
- Sandbox credits: 60,000 tokens, one-time, account-level pool for cohort teams
- Dedicated conversion pricing: 25% off list for month 1, 20% off list for months 2–3, contingent on a 6-month reserved commit signed within 30 days of the pilot end. If the commit is not executed, charges revert to list and any discounts will be reconciled on the invoice.
- Co-branded onboarding: 1 full day + 30 days of priority CS office hours included
- MOU & signature: Contracts (contracts@redwood.ai) will send a DocuSign-ready one-pager within 24 hours; please confirm signatory (SeedFoundry LLC).

Next steps for SeedFoundry:
1) Confirm signatory and whether PO is required (you indicated no PO).
2) Sign the MOU when Contracts sends it.
3) Provide billing contact for sandbox credits.

I attached a draft MOU (informal draft) to speed review — Contracts will replace with the official DocuSign. Looking forward to getting SeedFoundry into the cohort flow.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
